s: war between Nebuchadnezzar and Arphaxad took place in great plain (borders of Ragau)
q: King Nebuchadnezzar made war with King Arphaxad in the great plain. This plain is on the borders of Ragau.

s: war between Nebuchadnezzar and Arphaxad outcome Nebuchadnezzar prevailed (battle in the seventeenth year)
q: he prevailed in his battle, and turned to flight all the army of Arphaxad

s: Nebuchadnezzar defeated Arphaxad (killed him in the mountains of Ragau)
q: He took Arphaxad in the mountains of Ragau, struck him through with his darts, and utterly destroyed him to this day.

s: Nebuchadnezzar captured Ecbatana (took towers, plundered streets)
q: He came to Ecbatana and took the towers, plundered its streets, and turned its beauty into shame.

s: peoples of the western lands (Nebuchadnezzar's summoned) disposition toward nebuchadnezzar disregard (refused his summons to war and were not afraid of him)
q: All those who lived in all the land made light of the commandment of Nebuchadnezzar king of the Assyrians, and didn’t go with him to the war; for they were not afraid of him

s: Nebuchadnezzar feels toward peoples of the western lands (Nebuchadnezzar's summoned) (anger; swore vengeance by his throne and kingdom)
q: Nebuchadnezzar was exceedingly angry with all this land, and he swore by his throne and kingdom that he would surely be avenged

s: Nebuchadnezzar has army army (Nebuchadnezzar's army) (exceedingly great multitude of men of war of sundry nations)
q: he and all his company of sundry nations—an exceedingly great multitude of men of war

s: Nebuchadnezzar held banquet (Nebuchadnezzar's feast at Nineveh) (with his army, one hundred twenty days)
q: There he took his ease and banqueted, he and his army, for one hundred twenty days.

q: Nebuchadnezzar, who reigned over the Assyrians in Nineveh, the great city
